generate_dataset: generate a random dataset with entities and edges compatible with a PyTorch BigGraph config schema
init_embeddings: initialize random embeddings and model checkpoint files for a given config and target directory
broadcast_nums: broadcast a list of integers to a single value, raising an error if multiple distinct values exist
test_default: test default PyTorch BigGraph training and evaluation with a single entity type and relation
test_resume_from_checkpoint: test resuming PyTorch BigGraph training from an existing checkpoint with a specific version number
